title: Revenant-Plugin: Validation & Integration Testing
description:
Build validation framework and integration testing for Revenant-Plugin.

## Objective
Validate that Revenant plugin outputs match or exceed current cron setup before deployment.

## Scope
- Validation test suite (test/VALIDATION-PLAN.md)
- Data parity testing (compare plugin outputs vs cron outputs)
- Token efficiency measurement
- Timeout failure measurement
- Model crash prevention measurement
- Data continuity testing
- Agent payload quality testing
- Integration testing (deploy plugin, switch cron jobs)

## Guardrails
- WORK ONLY in: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants
- NO GitHub pushes or modifications
- NO upstream pushes or modifications to anything outside the local project folder
- NO modifications to existing Remnant-Research repo
- NO modifications to existing cron jobs or OpenClaw config
- All work stays in the designated project workspace directory

## Reference Material
- Validation plan: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants\test\VALIDATION-PLAN.md
- Architecture: D:\.openclaw\workspace-revenants\docs\ARCHITECTURE.md
- Current cron outputs: D:\.openclaw\workspace\remnant-research\gnw\cognitive-cycle\cycle-logs\*
- GRAO outputs: D:\.openclaw\workspace\remnant-research\tpg-grao\*

## Deliverables
- Validation test scripts and results
- Integration deployment plan
- Success criteria verification
- Documentation in docs/

## Success Criteria
- All 6 validation criteria pass (data parity, token reduction, timeouts, crashes, continuity, payload quality)
- Full system operation validated
- Zero regressions confirmed
- Adequate replacement confirmed
